title: still present since round 4: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state BEFORE the unsaved-changes guard fires
evidence: client.gleam:491-496: `_, True -> case is_public_route(route) { True -> // Exiting the demo must clear every demo-populated store field ... handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)` ; guard at 5404-5412 inside handle_browser_change: `// Unsaved changes guard: intercept navigation away from edit page let #(updated_model, eff) = case model.route, route { routes.VacancyEdit(edit_id), r -> case r { routes.VacancyEdit(_) -> #(updated_model, eff) _ -> case model.vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes {`
detail: The guard evaluates against the cleared model: its intercept leaves a non-demo model stranded on the demo edit URL, and confirm/cancel both re-enter demo via is_demo_route, discarding the guarded edits anyway.
recommended_fix: In the public-route exit arm, run the dirty-edit check before clear_demo_state (or skip the guard entirely in demo and navigate directly).

title: still present since round 4: demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage
evidence: UserToggledComparison (not intercepted by demo_update — grep confirms no arm): `save_comparison_ids(new_ids)` (3546); UserDismissedSweepNudge (not intercepted): `save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed))` (4957); handle_browser_change demo navigation also runs `save_comparison_ids([])` (5431, 5436).
